# 📝 Change Request

Request ID, requester, date, area and priority.

## Problem and expected outcome
Describe user impact and measurable acceptance criteria.

## Proposed change
Summarize source modules, UI/game-rule impact, data/security/privacy implications and documentation changes.

## Alternatives
Describe options and rejection reasons.

## Impact assessment
Performance, accessibility, browser compatibility, dependencies, operations, support and licensing.

## Test/rollout plan
Automated tests, manual QA, deployment and rollback.

Approve / Reject / Defer, reviewer, date and linked ADR/issue.
